Bajaj Auto Ltd has informed the Exchange that: "The board of directors met today (May 17, 2007) to consider, the demerger of (1) the two and three wheeler manufacturing undertaking ("Manufacturing Undertaking") and (2) its Strategic Businesses comprising the generation of wind-energy using wind-farms, the insurance business conducted through its joint ventures Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Company Limited and Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited, financial products distribution business conducted through Bajaj Allianz Financial Distributors Limited and interests in retail / consumer finance business conducted by Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd. (collectively, the "Strategic Business Undertaking") to two newly incorporated subsidiaries, Bajaj Holdings and Investment Limited ("BHIL") and Bajaj Finserv Limited ("BFL"). The Manufacturing Undertaking shall vest in BHIL and Strategic Business Undertaking shall vest in BFL. The demerger will be subject to all the requisite statutory, regulatory and corporate approvals, including approvals of the RBI, stock exchanges, the respective boards and shareholders. The board has unanimously approved the proposed demerger of the undertaking of the company as above, with effect from the closing hours of 31 March 2007, the Appointed Date. After the demerger, each shareholders would, for every share held in the company, a) continue to hold one share of the Company of face value of Rs.10 each fully paid up, b) be allotted one share of BHIL of face value of Rs.10 each fully paid up and c) be allotted one share of BFL of face value of Rs.5 each fully paid up. As part of the restructuring, BHIL shall be renamed as "Bajaj Auto Limited" and the existing Bajaj Auto Limited shall be renamed as "Bajaj Holdings and Investments Limited". J M Morgan Stanley Pvt Ltd and M/s J Sagar Associated have acted as Advisors for the restructuring".
